items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: But we tried to get him in the Eureka band. Mm-hmm. We all went to the rehearsal and all. He didn't all come in. We played the music for him.

ctx.x: If I could play clarinet like that boy, I would stick to clarinet. But he... He... He... He's a good player. And they can read good. But he don't think he can play enough. Shit. I got a match. Yeah. If I could play Clown-Ed like that boy, I would stick to Clown-Ed. He don't think he could play. But he doesn't know.
Well, I heard him with the Gibson band the other day. You know him, Lawrence Den? Oh, yeah. That's the one you're talking about, Lawrence Den?

Mm-hmm. I don't care about him much because he's got a big cab from there. He got a lot of cabs. And then he got that job, too. But we tried to get him in the Eureka band. Mm-hmm. We all went to the rehearsal and all. He didn't all come in. We played the music for him. I said, go ahead and ask the other one. He said, but I can make it. I said, I know you can make it.
